title: Audit when exceptional repair can use independent batches
body:
## Result
Research note / mathematical audit. **No new κ.** Independent cleanup cells work for arbitrary payloads iff each is a union of cycles of the correction P=T S^-1.

For PR2250's earlier-source two-slot word at G=4, K=8, rho=2, the actual source requires post-raw address 0 to move to 65408 (raw preimage 65412). The 65536-address fibre has 64 cycles of length 512 and 32768 fixed points. Every proper dyadic contiguous target partition fails; residue cells modulo 128 pass. Whole-record repair tariffs add exactly over disjoint exhaustive partitions with a common valid key bound.

## Contribution and pins
This answers the endpoint part of PR2476's partition handoff and gives a conditional accounting corollary. PR1108 already supplies the saturation law/raw order; PR763 checks whole source/back-field fibres. No source bug or new supplier is claimed.

- Analysis base: bd1b3bc7174cddbfa4e30ac073dc134f48aa6e77.
- Refreshed submission parent: 7cfd2fd64bff65b0f01771fede3d11b37c06c68e.
- PR2250 executable source: d404b48a1e7b147556b309497d55089c837dddb2.
- PR2476 accounting: 32e88ddfd111b93fbcfb306514397cf406e4d5d4.
- PR1108 algebra: b76bb2853be4e7001508582b10913e32ad7aba9f.

## Reproduce
CPython 3.12, standard library, from the repository root:
```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compact-repair-partition-audit-seed66
```
Expected and observed: PASS_COMPACT_REPAIR_PARTITION_AUDIT addresses=2396160 orbit_length=512 physical_records=4096 no_new_kappa; six tests OK; PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

PASS: source-byte/blob checks; 2396160 address cases; 6635 permutation/partition pairs; 14946 tariff cases; 4096 original-interpreter records; clean optimized Git-free replay. Negative controls reject cross-cell repair, wrong sign, tampered source/blob/receipt, Boolean-vs-integer receipts and overwrite attempts. Metadata, syntax and diff checks pass.

## Limits and credit
Hand proof plus bounded replay, not formal verification. Scope: the stated no-communication interface and earlier-source two-slot family. Full records, global keys and a uniform per-cell tariff are required. Gathering, dispatch, metadata, merging, parking and cross-cell routing remain unimplemented/unpriced. No selected-supplier cold replay, full catalogue, repository-wide suite, Lean or hosted CI was run.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Douglas Colkitt, @martinxxx9/PR1108, John-Michael Smith/PR763, Jose Manuel/PR2250 and @ywz65/PR2476. Apache-2.0; retained source notices and exact hashes are included. Separate code paths share the same AI author. Bounded overlap refresh found no competing partition claim; upstream claim posting returned 403, so CLAIM.json records coordination locally.
